scientific_question: Study the carotid artery flow field to identify its strongest high-speed region. At each location, use the Euclidean magnitude of the available velocity vector as speed; retain values at or above the 90th percentile of non-zero speed; and treat face-connected retained locations as one region. Rank the resulting regions by peak speed and locate the selected region using the mean position of its retained locations. Present the principal evidence-supported findings you judge important, including the selected region’s strength and location and at least one additional scientifically relevant characterization of your choice.
